name: codemagic-patch-bitbucket
title: Codemagic Patch (Bitbucket)
description: Over-the-air updates for React Native and Capacitor apps, signing in with Bitbucket Cloud, on R2 or Google Cloud buckets.
notes: Before you install: Codemagic publishes no server image, so build one from the release tag into a private registry (Caravana's deploy/examples/codemagic-patch/RUNBOOK.md has a workflow for it) and add the registry's login in Settings, Registries. Make two buckets, one public and one private, and a key with read and write on both. On Google Cloud: the downloads URL is https://storage.googleapis.com/<public bucket>, give allUsers the role Storage Legacy Object Reader on it (read by name, no listing), and use a service account's HMAC key. On R2: give the public bucket a custom domain and use it as the downloads URL. In Bitbucket, Workspace settings, OAuth consumers, Add consumer: callback URL https://{{domain}}/auth/callback, This is a private consumer checked, permissions Account: Read and Email. Its Key and Secret go below. Sign in at https://{{domain}} with the admin email, which must be your confirmed primary email in Bitbucket. Both addresses are written into your apps' builds, so choose them once. Postgres is backed up every day at 03:00 UTC, keeping 14.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Server image
inputs.help: The image you built, with its version tag (not latest).

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Server domain
inputs.help: The API and dashboard. Its DNS must point at this server.

inputs.name: public_url
inputs.label: Downloads URL
inputs.help: Where apps download updates: the public bucket's address. https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket> on Google Cloud, or the R2 bucket's custom domain.

inputs.name: bucket
inputs.label: Public bucket
inputs.help: The public bucket: anyone may read its files.

inputs.name: internal_bucket
inputs.label: Private bucket
inputs.help: The bucket for the server's own files. It must never be public.

inputs.name: s3_endpoint
inputs.label: S3 endpoint
inputs.help: The buckets' S3 API: https://storage.googleapis.com on Google Cloud, https://<account ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com on R2.

inputs.name: s3_region
inputs.label: S3 region
inputs.help: auto on R2; the buckets' location on Google Cloud, such as us-central1.

inputs.name: bitbucket_client_id
inputs.label: Bitbucket consumer key
inputs.help: The Key of the Bitbucket OAuth consumer the dashboard signs in with.

inputs.name: admin_email
inputs.label: Admin email
inputs.help: The first admin of the dashboard.

inputs.name: bitbucket_client_secret
inputs.label: Bitbucket consumer secret
inputs.help: The Secret of the same OAuth consumer.

inputs.name: s3_access_key_id
inputs.label: S3 access key ID
inputs.help: With read and write on both buckets: an R2 API token, or a Google Cloud HMAC key of a service account.

inputs.name: s3_secret_access_key
inputs.label: S3 secret access key
inputs.help: From the same token or HMAC key.
